Intellisec is a specialist supplier of intelligent site management systems, based in Montague Gardens and established in 1998. The company's offering ranges from CCTV, access control and fire detection to public address systems, intruder alarms and electric fencing.

Each solution is customised to the client's specific requirements and operational environment, aiming to monitor and protect the most vulnerable parts of an organisation. The company says its own in-house teams install and maintain every system to guarantee quality, rather than outsourcing the work.

It suits businesses and sites that need an integrated security system rather than separate suppliers for cameras, access control and alarms.

items.description:
Kukoma Coffee Co. is a coffee shop on St George's Street in Simon's Town, roasting its own all-African coffee on site. Kukoma means 'kindness' in the Malawian Chichewa language, and the roastery says it supports sustainable practices in the coffee it sources.

The cafe pairs its coffee with free high-speed internet and runs home-brewing workshops, and it is open every day of the week. Besides espresso drinks such as a flat white, the cafe offers a coffee and cake special, including a Lindt double chocolate cake.

It suits remote workers and coffee lovers in Simon's Town who want to try African-roasted coffee in a relaxed, connected space.

Lello's is an Italian delicatessen in the De Waterkant area, run by the Turilli family, who are also known for their culinary work at Scarpetta. The deli is known for its freshly made focaccia sandwiches, including combinations such as mozzarella with parma ham and a classic caprese with tomato and basil.

The deli also stocks a wide selection of Italian pantry items and frozen meals to take home, including ready-made dishes such as beef lasagne, alongside homemade ice cream. The atmosphere is cosy, and the deli has been ranked among the best spots for quiche in Cape Town.

It suits shoppers who want authentic Italian deli food to eat in or take home, in a warm, family-run setting.

Lime Tree Cafe is a restaurant and pizzeria at the Sherwood Centre in Bergvliet, in Cape Town's Constantia Valley, where it has been serving guests for more than ten years. The cafe describes its guiding principle as offering a 'third place' where customers feel at home and can relax.

The restaurant has three distinct sections: a quieter pizza and deli area that is also home to its Limestone art space, a bustling main section, and an outside patio for al fresco dining. Its deli sells homemade biscuits, farm jams, wild raw honey, fresh sourdough, farm-fresh eggs and frozen pizza bases, along with ready-made frozen meals portioned for two.

It suits anyone from a morning coffee and scone to a family dinner with wine, and shoppers who want deli items or a frozen meal to take home.

Massimo's Ristorante Italiano is a family-run restaurant at Oakhurst Farm Park on Main Road in Hout Bay, where the owners are on site every day. The restaurant serves Italian thin-based pizza and Mediterranean dishes, with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options available, and has won Best Pizza in Africa awards in 2019 and 2021.

Ingredients are sourced as fresh and local as possible, and the restaurant runs a Pay It Forward donation scheme supporting Cape Town charities. Its own range of Italian spirits, Masimo's Spiriti Famosi, includes a Limone liqueur, an orange and chocolate Aranci, and a ginger Zenzero liqueur.

The restaurant is dog friendly, with a special menu for dogs and an outside play area for children. It suits families, dog owners and pizza lovers looking for a relaxed Italian meal in Hout Bay.

Nude Foods is a plastic-free grocery store at 5 Constitution Street in Zonnebloem, selling non-GMO, healthy and affordable wholefoods and earth-friendly body and home products. Everything in the store is sold by weight, so customers bring or buy containers rather than packaged goods.

The store sells reusable items such as Keep Cups alongside its food range, and it stocks goods including palm-oil-free, vegan chocolate spreads without preservatives. The shop closes for public holidays such as Heritage Day and reopens the next morning.

It suits shoppers who want to buy groceries and home products without single-use packaging, refilling their own containers in the store.

items.description:
TAH Table View is a veterinary hospital at 67 Blaauwberg Road, which joined the TAH group but has been serving the residents and pets of Table View since 1982. The practice offers full veterinary services, a theatre, and a retail vetshop selling premium food, treats and toys.

Its vet and retail hours run into the evening on weekdays, with shorter hours on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. For emergencies outside these hours, the practice refers clients to its sister branches in Bellville and Rosmead.

It suits pet owners in Table View and nearby suburbs who want a long-established veterinary practice with both medical care and a well-stocked pet shop on site.

The Bungalow is a beachfront restaurant and bar at Clifton, part of the Kove Collection, known for Mediterranean-style cuisine and cocktails close to Clifton 4th beach. Guests can arrive straight from the beach for cocktails on the terrace, which has ocean views, and the restaurant is described as a Cape Town institution.

Seasonal chef's specialities have included seafood linguine, a 600g aged T-bone, and a chicken or prawn curry, alongside the restaurant's regular Mediterranean menu. Reviewers highlight the ocean view from the terrace, the range of cocktails and mocktails, and the seafood options.

It suits beachgoers and diners who want a laidback but elevated meal with a view over Clifton's beaches.

The Eatery at Antrim House is a restaurant inside a redesigned 14-bedroom luxury guesthouse in Three Anchor Bay, part of the Antrim Collection. The restaurant is rated 4.3 on Google and offers a relaxed atmosphere with seasonal menus and two-course dining options aimed at both locals and hotel guests.

Menus cater for various dietary needs, including vegan, gluten-free and vegetarian options, and there are separate eatery and burger menus for a quick bite or a leisurely meal. The restaurant trades daily between 7:30am and 8:30pm.

It suits guests staying at Antrim House as well as outside diners who want an all-day restaurant with a guesthouse setting in Three Anchor Bay.

The Pole Yard is a hardware store, furniture maker and wholesaler at 39 Paarden Eiland Road, part of a small group that also has branches in Retreat and Vredenburg. The store stocks a wide range of building and hardware items, including tools, nails and cable ties, alongside card payment facilities on site.

Reviewers describe the staff as helpful, with one praising the advice and assistance given to carry items to a car, and another noting that some items are well priced while a small portion are overpriced. The bathroom facilities and the generally dusty environment were mentioned as less welcoming aspects of the site.

It suits builders, hobbyists and DIY customers in Paarden Eiland who want hands-on advice alongside a wide stock of hardware and building materials.

Tonic Design is a South African interior-architectural studio in Gardens, specialising in iconic furniture editions and interior programmes for residential, retail, hospitality and corporate spaces. Every piece is individually handcrafted by master carpenters, smiths, stonemasons and upholsterers, using an unorthodox mix of materials, technical precision and traditional techniques.

Its furniture range covers seating such as sofas, armchairs, dining chairs, benches and daybeds, tables of every kind, bedroom pieces, and storage units including servers, cabinets, consoles and bookcases. The studio also offers tailored interior consultations and can customise the colour, material and dimensions of almost any design to a client's needs.

It suits designers, architects and homeowners who want bespoke, locally handcrafted furniture rather than off-the-shelf pieces.

items.description:
Utopia is a rooftop restaurant on the 15th floor of 40 Chiappini Street in De Waterkant, serving a la carte and set menus that highlight seafood, meat and plant-based dishes. The a la carte menu offers a large selection of shellfish and fish dishes alongside flavoursome meat cuts, available daily.

The restaurant also runs a five-course tasting menu, with a vegetarian option, served Monday to Saturday from midday to 3:30pm. Its wine list is sourced from a range of terroirs, including a number of five-star award-winning wines, and waitstaff can advise on pairing wines with each dish.

It suits diners looking for a rooftop setting with sea and city views, whether for an a la carte lunch or a set tasting menu.

Antonio's Pizza Place is a restaurant on the harbour's edge in Gordon's Bay, with 30 years of experience serving pizzas, pastas, seafood, burgers, poultry and grilled meats. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available, and the restaurant describes its menu as built to suit a wide range of appetites.

Seating options include a spacious outdoor area, a covered patio, a lazy lounging corner and a cosy indoor section, so guests can choose their preferred setting. The restaurant has its own power supply, so it stays open and fully operational during load shedding, and it offers online ordering for those who want to eat from home.

It suits diners who want harbour views with their meal, or who want to order in when the power is out elsewhere.

Artformes is an art gallery and shop at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, focused on sculptural form within contemporary art, using mediums that might otherwise be overlooked. The name borrows from the French word 'forme', meaning shape, form or object of art, and the gallery aims to pioneer new vocabulary for contemporary sculptural work.

The gallery is open on weekdays, with Saturday visits by appointment only, and it is closed on Sundays and public holidays. It sits among the Mill's cluster of art and design shops and galleries, where visitors can browse several independent studios in one visit.

It suits art collectors and visitors to the Mill who want to see sculptural, contemporary art pieces rather than more traditional gallery fare, and who are curious about materials not often used in sculpture.

Bang K is a small-plate Thai restaurant on York Road in Muizenberg, set in a moody, intimate space styled like a dining room in someone's home. A long table runs down the middle of the room, repurposed from the chef's earlier private-dining venture on Bree Street, with smaller tables for two lining the walls.

The interior mixes black walls, candlelight and chandeliers with vintage ornaments sourced from markets, large bottles of sake, framed drawings and Asian paperbacks, alongside a gallery of black-and-white photo art above leather banquettes. The restaurant is a labour of love for its two owners, who did all of the renovating and decor themselves.

It suits diners who want a fresh, artfully presented take on Thai small plates in an atmospheric, home-like setting.

Beleza is a Portuguese-Italian restaurant and bar in Tamboerskloof, serving traditional Iberian fare and coffee since it opened in 2005. The restaurant sits alongside its on-site vintage boutique, Lembrancas, in one of Cape Town's hipster strongholds.

The owners built much of the restaurant's charm around upcycling, well before it became a popular idea elsewhere in the city: a mosaic at the front is made from mirror shards and off-cuts, and the chairs were re-covered after coming from a Methodist church. The restaurant has kept its following for close to two decades in a notoriously fickle restaurant scene.

It suits diners who want Portuguese-Italian food and good coffee in a characterful, upcycled setting in Tamboerskloof.

Bihari is a North Indian restaurant at the Southern Sun Newlands hotel, combining authentic flavours and traditional techniques with contemporary influences. Dishes are prepared in traditional tandoor ovens over hot open coals, and starters include fresh chicken and vegetable options, samosas, naan breads and kebabs.

Main courses include a variety of traditional curries and tandoor items such as tandoori chicken and tandoori prawns, with the restaurant's prawn korma a particular favourite among seafood lovers. Vegetarians have a wide choice of curries and tandoor dishes as well.

The restaurant is open for lunch and dinner daily, and guests staying at the hotel can order from the menu for in-room dining. It suits hotel guests and visitors to Newlands who want authentic North Indian food in the Southern Suburbs.

Bistro31 is the restaurant at the DoubleTree by Hilton Cape Town Upper Eastside hotel in Salt River, offering an extensive a la carte menu and all-day dining in a discreetly glamorous setting. Executive chef Simon Kemp, who has spent 15 years honing his craft across Europe and South Africa, runs a fusion-style kitchen that is also known for its handmade burgers.

Guests with specific dietary requirements can be accommodated with advance notice, and the chef is available to discuss catering for business conferences or special events at the hotel, including tailor-made menus for small groups entertaining in the hotel's loft suites. The restaurant has underground parking for guests.

It suits hotel guests and visitors to Salt River who want an all-day dining option with a flexible menu for both casual meals and private events.

Blue Water Cafe is a family-friendly restaurant on Imhoff Farm in Kommetjie, set in an original Cape Dutch farmstead dating back to 1743. The cafe offers a relaxed outdoor atmosphere with views of Long Beach across the vineyards from a traditional stoep and lawn, serving new Cape-style food and wood-fired pizzas with vegan and gluten-free options.

The menu draws on Cape heritage, using local and seasonal ingredients, and the cafe suits both couples wanting a secluded table in the Cape Dutch interior and larger groups in the sheltered outside area. A safe enclosed garden, jungle gym and neighbouring animal farmyard keep children occupied while adults eat.

The cafe delivers pizza seven days a week in the early evening, ordered online or through its Facebook page. It suits families visiting Imhoff Farm who want a relaxed meal with farm views and space for children to play.

Botanica Jewellery is a jewellery studio at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, creating handcrafted pieces with a botanical twist inspired by the fauna and flora of the Western Cape. Each piece is crafted locally in Cape Town, combining hand engraving and hand carving with modern manufacturing methods.

The studio works in sterling silver and gold to create lifestyle jewellery, engagement rings, wedding bands and special commissions, aiming for pieces that can be treasured and passed down. The studio trades on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

It suits shoppers looking for locally made, nature-inspired jewellery or a bespoke commission while visiting the Mill.

items.description:
El Burro Taqueria is a Mexican restaurant on the corner of Kloof Nek Road and New Church Street in Tamboerskloof, built around a tight menu of tacos, quesadillas and margaritas served in a casual, upbeat setting. Regulars return for the prawn and salmon dishes alongside classic pork and fish tacos, the butternut quesadilla, and a steady supply of chips and salsa, with vegan options on the menu for those skipping meat and seafood altogether.

The taqueria trades from midday into the evening, Monday to Saturday, and has built a loyal following among people who treat it as a regular stop rather than a once-off visit. It suits anyone after a quick, flavourful taco and a good margarita in a relaxed, no-fuss setting close to Kloof Nek.

Epping Industrial Suppliers is a family-owned industrial wholesaler based in Cape Town, founded by Arthur Pratt in 1973 and now run by its third generation. The company serves industries including manufacturing, hospitality, cleaning services, engineering and retail, with 50 years of experience behind it.

It partners with leading global brands to offer tailored solutions such as washroom supplies, personal protective equipment and specialised tapes, and its warehouse stocks more than 1,500 products to ensure fast, reliable service. Many staff members have worked at the company for more than 25 years.

It suits businesses across several sectors that need a single wholesale supplier for workplace consumables and industrial products.

Evertsdal Guest House is in the northern suburbs of Cape Town, close to Durbanville and Tygervalley, and spread across several named houses including Kendal House, Kendal Manor, Bergkruine House, The Residence and Vergesig House. Durbanville is known for its wine route, with many wineries and restaurants on the edge of the village, while Tygervalley offers shopping at well-known retail stores.

The guest house hosts conferencing alongside accommodation, with boardrooms that can seat up to eight delegates, a 55-inch plasma screen for presentations, and access to a peaceful private garden courtyard. It also caters for bridal functions and other events, with early bird specials and long weekend discounts offered from time to time.

It suits business travellers needing a meeting space as well as leisure guests wanting easy access to the Durbanville wine route and Tygervalley shopping.

items.description:
Maru is a Korean steakhouse in Cape Town's CBD, pairing the bold flavours of Korea with the craft of a modern steakhouse. The menu features premium cuts grilled to order alongside Korean fried chicken, with the kitchen describing its approach as inspired by Korean tradition without being defined by it.

The restaurant offers a butcher's experience set menu and a by-the-bucket set menu, along with separate drinks and dessert menus, and it can be booked for private events and functions. A daily Magic Hour from 4pm to 5:30pm offers 50% off selected bubbles, beer and wine by the glass.

It suits diners who want a contemporary take on Korean barbecue, with a livelier, modern steakhouse atmosphere rather than a traditional Korean BBQ setting.

Medindi Manor is a luxury guest house in Rosebank, offering the design and sophistication of a boutique hotel with the personalised service and affordability of a guest house. It has 15 rooms, making it suited to group bookings, and the owners say a high rate of returning guests reflects the stylish accommodation and staff.

The guest house is in the southern suburbs, a ten-minute drive from Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens and convenient for Cape Town International Airport and the V&A Waterfront. It is about 3km from the University of Cape Town and close to Newlands Cricket and Rugby stadiums, with the Constantia Wine Valley a short scenic drive away.

It suits groups, sports fans visiting Newlands, and travellers who want a boutique-style stay with easy access to the university and the Constantia wine route.

Mzansi Restaurant is a township restaurant in Langa, offering what it calls an authentic South African experience away from the city centre's tourist restaurants. The restaurant serves buffet-style food with vegan options available, and bookings are essential as it does not accept walk-ins.

Reviewers on TripAdvisor, where the restaurant holds more than 1,600 reviews, describe being given an introduction to the history of the restaurant and the area, with staff on hand to talk through the experience. Live music and entertainment form part of a visit, and the restaurant arranges transport for guests who need it, given its location in a township.

It suits visitors who want a guided, hosted introduction to township dining, food and music rather than a typical sit-down restaurant visit.

Newlands Brewery, dating back to 1820, is the oldest operating brewery in South Africa and runs a guided Beer Experience tour of its site in Newlands. The roughly hour-long tour covers the brewery's history, its approach to sustainability, and a walk through the brewing process across the brewhouse, fermentation, packaging and warehouse areas.

The tour also takes in the on-site Newlands Spring Brewing Company, a specialty brewery, and ends with a tasting and a drink or two in the brewery's historic pub. Tours run Tuesday to Friday at midday and on Saturdays at 10am and midday, with a maximum group size of 20 people, and pre-booking is required.

The tour costs R150 per person, with a reduced rate for pensioners and students, and it suits beer enthusiasts and visitors who want to see how one of the country's oldest breweries works.

Ozone Clinic Cape Town is a wellness clinic at 2nd Avenue in Harfield Village, offering ozone therapy through a HOCATT sauna pod treatment. A 15 to 30-minute session starts with a carbonic acid cycle, where CO2 combines with steam in the pod to open the pores, before oxygen is passed over an electrode to produce ozone in the steam.

The clinic says the treatment can burn up to 600 calories in half an hour while detoxing and energising the body, and that it can support treatment for a wide range of conditions alongside other natural products used at the clinic. The treatment combines a whole-body detox with a sauna session in one sitting.

It suits clients interested in ozone therapy and detox treatments who want a combined sauna and wellness session in Harfield Village.

Sapphire Corporate Solutions is a corporate services company based in Ndabeni, offering bespoke uniforms and clothing manufactured locally, along with stationery, consumables and supply chain management. Its services extend to full turnkey customised lifestyle and service programmes delivered into Africa, break bulk distribution and warehousing, and drop-ship services.

The company also covers branded merchandise, gifting and event solutions, as well as bespoke technology integrations, app development and e-commerce support. It describes itself as driven by partnership, aiming to take on non-core tasks such as uniforms and retail stationery so clients can focus on their core business.

It suits businesses that want uniforms, branded merchandise or supply chain services handled by a single corporate partner.

Simon's Town Guest House is a family owned and run bed and breakfast with spectacular views over False Bay, about five minutes' walk from Glencairn Beach. It has five luxuriously appointed en-suite bedrooms, each with its own private sitting area, named after rooms such as the Shawu, Kambaku, Mafunyane, Joao and Shingwedzi.

Breakfast is included in the room rate, with both a continental and a cooked selection served in the guest dining room or on the outdoor, sea-facing patio. The guest house is close enough to Simon's Town to reach the Cape's major attractions and activities by car.

It suits couples and travellers who want a cosy, family-run guesthouse with sea views and a proper breakfast near Simon's Town.

items.description:
Spec-Savers Rondebosch is an optometry store at Shop G23 in the Rondebosch Main and Fountain Centre on Main Street, trading under new management since December 2012. The branch has one testing room equipped with the latest optometric equipment and a team that includes a qualified optometrist, a practice manager and an optical dispenser.

The branch describes itself as living by the idea of affordable eyecare, and it says it has grown considerably since the change in management. Staff aim to identify each customer's visual needs and match them with frames suited to their personality and style.

It suits residents of Rondebosch who want an eye test or new glasses from a team with its own in-house testing facilities.

The Sports Concept Store is a high-end sportswear retailer specialising in performance running shoes and athletic apparel, stocking international brands including ASICS, HOKA, On and Under Armour alongside Nike, Wilson, Shokz, Crocs, Hey Dude and NNormal. The range is built around supplying some of the fastest-growing sports brands in the world, geared toward serious runners as much as everyday walkers and gym-goers after proper footwear.

The store trades from Shop D03 in Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village in De Waterkant, alongside the centre's other shops and cafes. It's a fitting stop for anyone shopping for a new pair of running shoes or technical apparel, whether training for a race or simply wanting shoes built to last.

Technoline Projects is a 20-year-old engineering design, project management and contracting firm based in Thornton, originally founded to serve the cellular and telecommunications industries. The company provides engineering design, project management and contracting services, and lists telecoms infrastructure among its areas of work.

The firm is a BBBEE Level 1 corporation, with all directors actively involved in managing the company, and it says it actively pursues black economic empowerment and partnership or joint-venture approaches when selecting contractors and sub-suppliers. Its stated vision is to become the preferred project management and engineering company in the Western region.

It suits clients in the telecommunications and construction industries who need a project management and engineering partner with a long track record in the sector.

Thai World is a Thai restaurant in Harfield Village, housed in an old house that has been converted into a restaurant, at 49 2nd Avenue on the corner of Surrey Street. The kitchen serves fresh, fragrant dishes full of spices, including red, yellow and green curries with a choice of beef, chicken, seafood, pork or vegetable.

The menu also features rice and noodle dishes, satay and soups, along with different daily specialty dishes that guests can ask about on arrival. The interior is interesting and the atmosphere welcoming, with reviewers describing the staff as incredibly friendly.

It suits diners who want a characterful Thai meal in a converted house setting in Harfield Village, for either lunch or dinner.

The Dental People is a dental practice at Centre Point Shopping Centre in Milnerton, offering professional dental care at cash rates set 20 to 40% below standard medical aid rates. The practice says it was founded on the idea that dental care should be affordable without compromising on quality, with no hidden costs or unnecessary procedures.

It is just minutes from Cape Town's CBD and easily reached from Bloubergstrand, Table View, Parklands, Century City, De Waterkant and Green Point, with ample parking and an online booking system. The practice accepts patients on selected medical aid plans as well as cash-paying patients.

It suits patients across the northern and southern suburbs who want straightforward, transparently priced dental care close to the CBD.
